svg.title: Latchwing concept: fitted to a fridge
svg.desc: Isometric illustration of a fridge with a sensor on the frame, a magnet on the door, a sealed housing with its cable leaving from below, and a plain notice on the door. It is a concept, not a final design.
svg.text: Reed or hall. Wakes the device
